flagships.name: TalonCV
flagships.tagline: Private, explainable interview coaching: speech, language and vision models that run entirely in the browser.
facts: Five model families in Web Workers: Whisper, MiniLM, YOLO11-face (ONNX), MediaPipe, SmolLM2
Time-aligned audio, visual and transcript evidence feeds deterministic, explainable scores
No backend and no inference API: static Next.js export, sessions stored in IndexedDB

flagships.name: Morph
flagships.tagline: Depth-compresses Hugging Face causal LMs, then uses teacher–student distillation to recover what pruning loses.
facts: Selects transformer blocks uniformly across the teacher's depth and transfers their weights into a smaller student
Objective: next-token CE + temperature-scaled KL to the teacher + optional hidden-state MSE
4/8-bit teacher quantization, BF16/FP16, gradient checkpointing; Llama, Mistral, Qwen2, GPT-2, Falcon, OPT, NeoX

flagships.name: OBSERV-E
flagships.tagline: Human-following perception and spoken guidance for visually impaired users. Won the StarkHacks 2026 Qualcomm Robotics Track.
facts: YOLO11 person detection, single-target lock, and tracking with an OpenCV / Lucas–Kanade optical-flow fallback
A constant-velocity Kalman filter projects the gimbal target state at 100–300 Hz, decoupled from inference rate
On-device hazard detection, an optional asynchronous VLM scene narrator, and speech that fires only when something changes

projects.name: EcoCAR Sensor Fusion
projects.tagline: Requirements, validation tests and real-time C++/RTMaps modules for lead-vehicle detection and driver monitoring.

projects.name: Lane Detection Study
projects.tagline: ResNet-18 vs EfficientNet-B0 vs MobileNetV2, each trained with and without augmentation: a 6-run grid with metrics, plots and video.

projects.name: RL Lane-Keeping Simulator
projects.tagline: PPO agents in a custom simulator, comparing camera, camera+LiDAR and full-stack sensing on collisions, lane deviation and completion.

projects.name: ConfusionClassifier
projects.tagline: A club-fair game where players try to drive a GoEmotions text classifier to a uniform 25/25/25/25 prediction.

more: Auditable leadership-outcome reporting: async CampusGroups export client, deterministic semantic read of weekly reports, Neon Postgres. Next.js + TypeScript.
Maps job-posting skill demand to certification objectives to help a club decide which certifications to fund. FastAPI, Next.js, CLI and PDF export.
Offline Godot 4 game that teaches cloud and ML system design: architectures appear as constellations you inspect, scale and fail over.
SPF/DKIM/DMARC screening automation for Technology Transition Paradigm, with DoH lookups (Google, Cloudflare) and checkdmarc validation.
Full-stack lab-access management for Illinois Tech Robotics. Next.js 14, Neon Postgres, Drizzle ORM.
The source for danishnadar.com: TanStack Start, React, Supabase CMS, an LLM-backed portfolio guide and a 3D skills experience.

leadership.body: Leads the student ML community: technical workshops, build sessions and public demos such as ConfusionClassifier at the club fair.
Previously Treasurer and Instructor. Ran budgets and workshops (AI/ML, Linux, Python) and led an autonomous robot-fleet project.
Leads autonomy software for the team's lunar robotics entry: perception, localization, mapping and planning.
Technology learning for older adults: an AI-narrated lesson pipeline, plain-language assistance and the model/inference stack.
Connected & automated vehicle engineer: perception requirements, validation test cases and real-time C++/RTMaps modules.
Selected for leadership development. Built AILA and LEAD-AI as AI tools for the Academy itself.
